text: Maidu singers generally use a relaxed and nonpulsating vocal technique. The music also has characteristic sequences and syncopations.

title: Maidu | Social Sciences and Humanities | EBSCO Research
text: The Maidu are Indigenous Americans primarily located in northeastern California, with a rich cultural heritage and a legacy of subsistence living through hunting, gathering, and fishing. Traditionally, Maidu people collected acorns, nuts, and berries, using grinding stones for food preparation.
